integrity_notes: The proof and standalone verification program are included. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for finite binary words with three ones; the sharp two-extremizer theorem assumes length at least seven. The finite reduction uses an included exhaustive integer test for 3432 base cases; the infinite step is analytic. No claims for larger weights, circular words, or absent subsequences.
title: Sharp minimal-absent-word capacity with three one-markers
